spans.s:
√daś 'make offering'
present: [1.] dā́śati etc. -- [2.] dāṣṭi -- [5.] dāśnóti 
perfect: dadā́śa etc. dádāśati dádāśas dádāśat dadāśvā́ṅs dāśvā́ṅs dāśivā́ṅs 
[aorist: adāśīt dāśiṣyati dāśitā ]
secondary: intensive: dādāś- -- desiderative: didāśiṣa- -- causative: adāśayat 
derivatives: dā́ś -dā́śa AV.+ dāśú V. dā́śuri V.

√das 'waste'
present: [4.] dásyati etc. -- [1.] dā́sati etc. 
perfect: dadasvā́ṅs dadāsa 
aorist: [2.] dasat etc. dásamāna? -- [5.] dāsīt 
[future: dasiṣyati dasitā dāsiṣyati dāsitā ]
verbal: dasta B.+ 
secondary: causative: dasaye dasayanta dāsayati etc. 
derivatives: dása -dasya V.S. -dasvant AV. dásyu V.+ dāsá V.+ -dāsin S.+ dāsanu B. -dāsuka B. 
Usually classed as two roots, das and dās; dā́sati etc. only with abhi.
